note: 第 3 批：南澳 11 个地点。每项只描述首帧图里看得见的东西，不加图里没有的地标、动物或文字。字段见 batch-clips.py。

locs.scene: city skyline at sunrise beside a calm river, a low arched footbridge, a white tent-roofed pavilion and a glass-fronted building on the far bank, green parkland in front and soft hills behind, eucalyptus branches at the upper left
locs.start: the river surface ripples gently and the reflections of the buildings shimmer
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the right and the eucalyptus leaves at the upper left sway lightly in a soft breeze
locs.still: the buildings, the footbridge and the hills
locs.ambience: Soft morning birdsong and faint water lapping
locs.sfx: a light breeze in the leaves

locs.scene: seaside promenade at sunset, a vintage red and cream tram standing on its rails beside an ornate sandstone building, tall pine trees, a long timber jetty reaching out over a calm sea
locs.keep: tram, the sandstone building, the jetty
locs.start: small waves wash onto the sand and the sunset light glows on the paving
locs.push_to: the jetty and the setting sun
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the left and the pine branches sway lightly in the sea breeze
locs.still: the tram, the building, the lamp posts and the jetty
locs.ambience: Gentle surf and a soft sea breeze

locs.scene: quiet village main street at golden hour, stone and half-timbered cottages with flower gardens on the left, tall gum trees arching over an empty road
locs.keep: cottages, the gum trees, the empty road
locs.start: dappled sunlight flickers on the road as the leaves move
locs.push_to: the far end of the empty street
locs.motion: The gum leaves overhead sway lightly and the garden flowers stir in a soft breeze throughout the shot
locs.still: the cottages, the fences and the tree trunks
locs.sfx: a light breeze through gum leaves

locs.scene: vineyard at sunset in front of a stone winery homestead with a long verandah, rows of grapevines with dark grapes in the foreground, rolling hills behind, a large gum tree at the upper left
locs.keep: stone homestead, the vine rows, the gum tree
locs.start: the vine leaves flutter and low sunlight flares through the gum tree
locs.push_to: the stone homestead beyond the vine rows
locs.rest: the homestead framed by the vines
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the right and the vine leaves and gum branches sway lightly in a warm breeze
locs.still: the homestead, the vineyard posts and the hills
locs.ambience: A warm evening breeze and distant birds

locs.scene: hillside vineyards at sunset rolling down toward a distant blue sea, a gum tree trunk at the left, a wooden post and vine leaves in the right foreground
locs.keep: vineyard rows, the distant sea, the gum tree
locs.start: the vine leaves in the foreground flutter and the sunlight glints on the distant sea
locs.push_to: the vineyard rows and the sea beyond them
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the right and the vine leaves and dry grasses sway lightly in a warm breeze
locs.still: the hills, the wooden posts and the tree trunk
locs.ambience: A warm breeze over open hills and distant birds

locs.scene: rugged coastal headland at sunset, a white and blue passenger ferry crossing a deep blue strait in front of a long island on the horizon, rocky cliffs and coastal shrubs in the foreground, gum leaves at the upper left
locs.keep: ferry, the cliffs, the island on the horizon
locs.start: swells roll through the strait and break white against the rocks below
locs.rest: the ferry with the island behind it
locs.motion: The ferry keeps its shape and glides slowly to the right trailing a white wake, clouds drift slowly to the left, and the coastal grasses bend in the wind
locs.still: the cliffs, the rocks and the island
locs.ambience: Wind over a headland and surf on rocks below

locs.scene: huge wind-sculpted granite boulders streaked with orange lichen on a bare rock dome above the sea at sunset, tussock grass in the foreground
locs.keep: granite boulders, the rock dome, the sea
locs.start: waves break in white spray on the rocks at the right
locs.rest: the boulders against the sunset sky
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the left and the tussock grass bends in the wind throughout the shot
locs.still: the boulders and the rock dome
locs.ambience: A steady sea wind and surf below the rocks

locs.scene: fishing harbour at sunset, three fishing boats moored at timber wharves on calm water, silos and sheds at the left, a low headland across the bay, rocks and shrubs in the foreground
locs.keep: fishing boats, the wharves, the silos
locs.start: the water ripples softly and the reflections of the boats waver
locs.motion: The boats keep their shape and rock very slightly at their moorings, clouds drift slowly to the right, and the foreground shrubs stir in a light breeze
locs.still: the wharves, the silos and the headland
locs.ambience: Calm harbour water lapping against hulls and timber

locs.scene: outback mining landscape at sunset, a pale sandstone hillside with dugout doorways cut into the rock, white cone-shaped heaps of dug earth on red ground, a small timber mine headframe on the ridge
locs.keep: sandstone hillside, the dugout doorways, the white heaps
locs.start: a thin veil of dust drifts low across the red ground
locs.push_to: the dugout doorways in the hillside
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the left, a thin veil of dust drifts to the right near the ground, and the dry shrubs tremble in a hot breeze
locs.still: the hillside, the white heaps and the headframe
locs.ambience: A dry desert wind over open ground

locs.scene: deep cobalt-blue crater lake ringed by steep limestone cliffs and green bush at sunset, rocks and grasses on the rim in the foreground, gum leaves at the upper left
locs.keep: blue lake, the crater cliffs, the rim
locs.start: cloud reflections slide across the blue water and fine ripples cross the lake
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the right and the rim grasses and gum leaves sway lightly in a breeze
locs.still: the crater cliffs and the rim rocks
locs.ambience: A light breeze on a high rim and distant birds

locs.scene: long timber jetty crossing calm shallow water at sunset, rows of oyster racks in the shallows, a sandy shore with rocks in the foreground, distant silos at the far left
locs.keep: timber jetty, the oyster racks, the shore
locs.start: the shallow water ripples and the sunset reflection shimmers
locs.push_to: the jetty and the oyster racks
locs.motion: Clouds drift slowly to the right and small ripples run toward the shore throughout the shot
locs.still: the jetty, the oyster racks and the silos
locs.ambience: Still shallow water lapping on sand
